joint_divisible_2_3.scope: Exploratory exact joint Iwahori2x3 return check, not the complete all-prime sieve.

mixed_and_unit_2_3.scope: Exact actual mixed and both-unit Cartan-normalizer return checks, finite only.

ramified_23_actual_brandt.scope: Finite actual level-23 axis-compact Brandt returns, both norm characters, and simultaneous D2/D3 primitive selection. Not a proof of the unrestricted spectral theorem.

ramified_23_nonsquare_actual_brandt.scope: Additional actual ramified-axis return check covering both norm-character signs; finite only.

divisor_bound.scope: For p>=128 use a+1<=2^a<=p^(a/7); for smaller p the displayed decreasing adjacent ratio proves the complete maximum. Thus tau(n)<=C*n^(1/7) for every positive n.

mass_bound.scope: Exact rational masses rounded upward, plus a complete decreasing-series bound over every remaining odd integer.

ramified_residue_gate.scope: The residue model Z23[j]+Z23[j]*sqrt(-23) is established in the proof. This enumerates its norm fibers and biased two-character axis gate; scalar Hensel squares supply all principal units.

onset.scope: Exact integer cutoff comparisons and conversion constant; the written proof supplies uniform spectral error and complete tail estimates.

scope: Exact finite Brandt/Iwahori/Cartan-normalizer returns, ramified norm characters, and complete rational/integer bounds supporting the written effective theorem. These checks do not replace its infinite correspondence, spectral and lattice arguments, or establish external/formal verification.
